sources.title: GitHub - dudefication/mulligan
sources.snippet: Mulligan requires a success/failure signal — a verifier, a test, a tool result, an accepted/ rejected. It is built for work agents (coding, data, ops, support) where actions have outcomes, not open-ended chat where "correct" is undefined.

sources.title: sim-square-narrow-c02-auto-iql-success-bc-n32-policy-rollouts
sources.snippet: Policy rollout dataset for the sim-square-narrow task as part of the Mulligan project, containing 100 episodes of simulated robot manipulation data generated from an auto-IQL success-based behavior cloning policy.
